purpose: Ingest cross-domain sources found during post-coverage multiplicity sampling and upgrade the raw-coverage analyzer from binary coverage to collision-depth, namespace-diversity and revisable-no-hit metrics.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, standard, material record, operational precedent or information item receives a Worldshepherd use when it materially improves any capability, or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: NVD/vendor mirrors, preprint/final-paper copies, registry mirrors and security-scanner aliases for the same underlying item are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: CVE IDs, catalog IDs, article IDs, dataset IDs and scanner plugin IDs may be highly useful to Worldshepherd but carry zero automatic Glob evidence unless the matched digits independently encode a verified physical quantity or relation.

sources.title: CVE-2026-25243 — Redis RESTORE serialized-value validation flaw
sources.note: Use as a hostile-deserialization and privileged-command ACL test case. 25243 is the CVE identifier and is separate from the existing Eu2+ spectroscopy P1 at 25243 cm^-1.

sources.title: CVE-2022-25243 — Vault PKI wildcard-certificate policy enforcement flaw
sources.note: Use as a policy-enforcement test where configuration semantics must be verified by outcome, not merely stored policy attributes. 25243 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: CVE-2020-25243 — Siemens LOGO! Soft Comfort project-import zip slip
sources.note: Use as an engineering-project/archive ingestion hardening case: imported project bundles must be path-normalized and sandboxed before extraction. 25243 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: CVE-2025-39699 — Linux RISC-V IOMMU null dereference
sources.note: Use as a kernel error-contract case: callers must explicitly handle null/unmapped returns before dereference. 39699 is the CVE identifier and is separate from W II spectroscopy evidence.

sources.title: CVE-2026-39699 — AI Workflow Automation missing authorization
sources.note: Use as an agent/workflow authorization test case: automation endpoints must enforce access control independently of UI affordances. 39699 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: Goods transported — quarterly national rail transport statistics
sources.authority: Spain datos.gob.es / Instituto Nacional de Estadistica
sources.note: Use as a public logistics/time-series dataset for ingestion, trend/reliability testing and supply-chain analytics. 75697 is an API dataset identifier.

sources.title: Quantifying Spatial Shadow Zones and Their Association With Hospital Falls in Acute Care Unit: Real-Time Location System Observational Study
sources.note: Use the UWB RTLS validation, spatial coverage/shadow-zone metric and threshold-sensitivity analysis as a general sensor-coverage and blind-zone benchmark. 75697 is the article identifier.

sources.title: Malassezia pachydermatis research strain ATCC 96750
sources.note: Use the lot/certificate, storage, handling, sequence cross-reference and legal-use metadata as a provenance/custody schema reference for governed research assets. 96750 is the catalog identifier and does not change the existing N I spectroscopy P1.

sources.title: CVE-2017-7467 — minicom VT100 escape-sequence buffer overflow
sources.note: Use as a hostile-terminal/input-parser hardening case. The matched 99639 belongs to a Tenable plugin identifier, not the CVE or physical quantity.

information_updates.finding: The raw-coverage analyzer now reports record depth, namespace diversity, sparse targets, densest targets and targets whose earlier defined-pass NO_HIT was later superseded by an occurrence. This turns post-coverage accumulation into a measurable search-behavior dataset.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Collision depth and namespace diversity characterize retrieval behavior and identifier prevalence; they do not increase physical Glob evidence.

information_updates.finding: The 2025 RTLS study validates a spatial blind-zone metric using UWB tracking, a measured positional-error baseline and sensitivity sweeps over spatial and temporal thresholds. The same pattern can be adapted for facility/sensor coverage maps and observability-gap testing.
information_updates.claims_boundary: The hospital outcome relationship is domain-specific; Worldshepherd should reuse the measurement/coverage method, not generalize the clinical effect without validation.

information_updates.finding: ATCC's strain record provides a compact custody model combining stable catalog identity, lot-specific certificate access, storage/handling constraints, sequence cross-references, provenance/history and permitted-use terms. This is a useful template for governed physical research assets beyond biology.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Use as a data-governance pattern only; no biological capability claim is implied.

next_actions: Continue post-coverage multiplicity sampling, prioritizing states with one record or one namespace according to the analyzer rather than only collision-dense targets.
Persist periodic collision-depth snapshots so search-source changes and revised no-hits can be compared over time.
Cross-reference security lessons against the actual Worldshepherd dependency/runtime inventory before opening remediation requirements.
Continue same-system topology and relational verification for W II, Sr I and other physical candidates with fixed tolerance and experiment-wide multiple-testing/false-discovery controls.
